The Refining Capacity Question
In a post on
X

on Monday, De Haan said that refiners in the U.S. are “running at the closest pace to capacity in years.” He added that there was no “more room for U.S. refiners to process more oil,” be it oil from Venezuela or anywhere else. “Refiners have been operating over 95% all summer long,” the analyst said.
